# OpenCodeConsole

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.OpenCode` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/OpenCode/OpenCodeConsole.cs#L14)

Reads the errors currently in Unity's Console so they can be handed to the agent.
"Fix the errors in the console" is the most common thing asked of an agent inside Unity, and
the agent cannot see the Console - compile errors are not in any file it can read. There is
no public API for the Console's contents, so this goes through the internal LogEntries type
the Console window itself uses, and fails soft (returns nothing) if that ever changes shape.

### WriteErrorsToFile(out int) {#writeerrorstofile-int32}

Writes the Console's current errors to a text file under Library and returns its path, or
null when there are none (or the Console could not be read). A file rather than prompt
text so a long stack trace travels as an attachment chip instead of flooding the composer.
